whatItIs.statement: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.

howToUse.statement: Use Field, FieldLabel, and FieldDescription to create an input with a label and description.

Use the native autoComplete prop, which maps to the HTML autocomplete attribute, to give browsers and password managers a hint about the field: for example type="email" with autoComplete="email", type="text" with autoComplete="username", and type="password" with autoComplete="current-password" (autoComplete="new-password" when choosing a password). Other standard values include name, one-time-code, organization, street-address, postal-code, and tel. The value is a plain string that the component passes through without validating it. Browsers and password managers may ignore or override the hint.

options.statement: Use the disabled option to disable the input.
Use the aria-invalid option to mark the input as invalid.
